# Muhammad — Full Stack Developer

> Muhammad is a full stack developer from Pakistan who ships reliable web products from idea to production. He builds with React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, Supabase, and MongoDB, and he develops high-converting custom Shopify themes with Liquid. He also builds AI-powered features and automations using LLM APIs, LangChain, and Python. His work spans SaaS products, e-commerce stores, travel and corporate websites, and offline desktop applications.

## Blog posts

- [Speed Up Your Shopify Theme: Liquid Tips that Move CRO Needles](https://muhammad.dev/blog/shopify-theme-speed.html): Profile a Shopify theme, cut app bloat and Liquid weight, and get Core Web Vitals into the green without a rebuild. A typical pass took LCP from ~4.1s to ~1.9s on a client store.
- [Next.js SEO in 2026: Metadata, Core Web Vitals, and GEO](https://muhammad.dev/blog/nextjs-seo.html): A practical checklist for per-page metadata, rendering strategy, and making a Next.js site understandable to both search engines and generative AI agents.
- [Your Website is Invisible to AI Agents. Fix That First.](https://muhammad.dev/blog/agentic-web.html): A growing share of product research happens inside AI agents. Lead with a one-sentence summary, real heading hierarchy, structured data, and specific, quotable claims.
